description: This Java source file defines the class AttributeMatcherPredicate, which implements the Predicate interface to filter attributes based on a provided map of attribute types and their serialized values. It is used in conjunction with commons-collections filtering to find matching attributes associated with customizable objects.

classes.name: AttributeMatcherPredicate
classes.description: Implements Predicate to evaluate if a customizable object contains attributes with values matching the given map.

methods.name: AttributeMatcherPredicate
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the predicate with a map of attribute types and their serialized string values.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates whether the given object (cast as a customizable) has attributes with values matching those in the serializedAttributeValues map.
